title: live-build (3.0~a57-1ubuntu54) UNRELEASED; urgency=medium
commit_message:
live-build (3.0~a57-1ubuntu54) UNRELEASED; urgency=medium
 .
   * Make the default mirror for arm64 be archive.ubuntu.com.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 7946249..7d6f7a8 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+live-build (3.0~a57-1ubuntu54) UNRELEASED; urgency=medium
+
+  * Make the default mirror for arm64 be archive.ubuntu.com.
+
+ -- Michael Hudson-Doyle <michael.hudson@ubuntu.com>  Thu, 16 Apr 2026 09:21:31 +1200
+
 live-build (3.0~a57-1ubuntu53) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * Add a --bootstrap-arch argument to lb config, to be used for variant
diff --git a/debian/patches/arm64-on-achive.patch b/debian/patches/arm64-on-achive.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0eedf44
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/arm64-on-achive.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+Description: arm64 is on archive.ubuntu.com now
+Author: Michael Hudson-Doyle <michael.hudson@ubunut.com>
+Origin: vendor
+Forwarded: no
+Last-Update: 2026-04-16
+---
+This patch header follows DEP-3: http://dep.debian.net/deps/dep3/
+--- a/functions/defaults.sh
++++ b/functions/defaults.sh
+@@ -405,7 +405,7 @@
+ 
+ 		ubuntu|kubuntu)
+ 			case "${LB_ARCHITECTURES}" in
+-				amd64|i386)
++				amd64|arm64|i386)
+ 					LB_MIRROR_BOOTSTRAP="${LB_MIRROR_BOOTSTRAP:-http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/}"
+ 					;;
+ 
+@@ -440,7 +440,7 @@
+ 
+ 		ubuntu|kubuntu)
+ 			case "${LB_ARCHITECTURES}" in
+-				amd64|i386)
++				amd64|arm64|i386)
+ 					LB_MIRROR_CHROOT_SECURITY="${LB_MIRROR_CHROOT_SECURITY:-http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/}"
+ 					;;
+ 
+@@ -462,7 +462,7 @@
+ 
+ 		ubuntu|kubuntu)
+ 			case "${LB_ARCHITECTURES}" in
+-				amd64|i386)
++				amd64|arm64|i386)
+ 					LB_MIRROR_CHROOT_VOLATILE="${LB_MIRROR_CHROOT_VOLATILE:-http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/}"
+ 					;;
+ 
+@@ -516,7 +516,7 @@
+ 
+ 		ubuntu|kubuntu)
+ 			case "${LB_ARCHITECTURES}" in
+-				amd64|i386)
++				amd64|arm64|i386)
+ 					LB_MIRROR_BINARY="${LB_MIRROR_BINARY:-http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/}"
+ 				;;
+ 
+@@ -548,7 +548,7 @@
+ 
+ 		ubuntu|kubuntu)
+ 			case "${LB_ARCHITECTURES}" in
+-				amd64|i386)
++				amd64|arm64|i386)
+ 					LB_MIRROR_BINARY_SECURITY="${LB_MIRROR_BINARY_SECURITY:-http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/}"
+ 					;;
+ 
+@@ -575,7 +575,7 @@
+ 
+ 		ubuntu|kubuntu)
+ 			case "${LB_ARCHITECTURES}" in
+-				amd64|i386)
++				amd64|arm64|i386)
+ 					LB_MIRROR_BINARY_VOLATILE="${LB_MIRROR_BINARY_VOLATILE:-http://archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/}"
+ 					;;
+ 
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series

--- a/debian/patches/series
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -50,3 +50,4 @@ lp-2033308-backup-and-restore-packaged-preferences.patch
 no-apt-key.patch
 ubuntu-no-chmod-broken-symlink.patch
 add-bootstrap-arch-arg.patch
+arm64-on-achive.patch
